evidence_excerpt: integrating vision-picking technology into supply chain operations
evidence_summary: GWC's official April 2024 release states that vision-picking technology using computer-vision systems, cameras and AR devices was integrated into warehouse operations and reports realized increases in picking speed and reduced labor effort.
adoption_interpretation: First observed qualifying computer-vision deployment in the currently audited GWC record; 2018-2023 require the same manual search protocol before assigning a definitive first-adoption year.
notes: Frozen codebook explicitly treats concrete computer-vision use as AI evidence. This is operational deployment, not generic automation: the source names computer-vision systems and states the technology was integrated into warehouse operations with observed performance effects.
